_comment: Copy to configs/paths.json (or point HAIRDECK_CONFIG to a copy) and edit. Every key is optional except root; environment variables HAIRDECK_ROOT, HAIRDECK_DATA, HAIRDECK_CKPT, HAIRDECK_LOGS, HAIRDECK_RESULTS, HAIRDECK_SCRATCH, HAIRDECK_WEIGHTS, HAIRDECK_DINOV3_REPO, HAIRDECK_SAM3_REPO take precedence. See hairdeck/paths.py.
